basis: Item 8 draft, 2026-10-29. Every rule that passed the bar in this session (e2 shadow_strong, e3b dark_shadow at 3.5, e4 tile_top) with the adopted saturation rule, judged as one change.

rules.name: shadow_strong
rules.basis: dark on the anti-sun side only, far beyond what polygon troughs and slopes produce, with a length that reads as a 0.5 to 3 m object

rules.name: dark_shadow
rules.basis: a dark object that still casts a shadow of the right length stands above the ground; a dark patch in the ground does not

rules.name: tile_top
rules.basis: the brightest compact object within its 512 m tile
